∀ (profile : Minidregg.Compiler.CompilerProfile) (law : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State) (leaf : Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf), Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf.ofRange profile law old new = Option.some leaf → law.subterm leaf.path = Option.some leaf.clause ∧ leaf.clause.isOrderAtom = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.inputsInRange profile leaf.clause old new = Bool.false ∧ leaf.before = Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.orderOperands leaf.clause old new).1 ∧ leaf.after = Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.orderOperands leaf.clause old new).2

∀ (profile : Minidregg.Compiler.CompilerProfile) (law : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf.ofRange profile law old new = Option.none ↔ Minidregg.Compiler.inputsInRange profile law old new = Bool.true

∀ {width : ℕ} (law : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State) (leaf : Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf), Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf.ofRange (Minidregg.Compiler.CompilerProfile.scalar width) law old new = Option.some leaf → ∃ left right, leaf.before = Option.some left ∧ leaf.after = Option.some right ∧ ¬(-2 ^ width ≤ right - left ∧ right - left < 2 ^ width)
